capture_note: Capture HEAD identifies the source repository, including uncommitted/untracked contents addressed by file hashes. It does not replace each historical experiment engine identity.
scope: Contextual dendritic, multi-area model and Litwin-Kumar research scripts, tests and small adjacent records. No engine implementation is imported.
validation: Every captured file hash checked; all Python files syntax parsed; high-confidence secret pattern scan found no matches. No historical experiment was rerun.
execution_status: Historical paths, optional packages and recorded engine identities must be supplied explicitly. Portable pinned Atlas reproduction is a separate pending workflow.
